scenes.headline: How a trillion-scale MoE was meant to work
scenes.sub: Monolith 1.0, as Basalt Labs described it, before the lab retracted it.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Aster! Monolith 1.0 was announced as a one point six trillion parameter open model. Then its own lab retracted it. The mechanisms it described are real, so here they are.

scenes.label: What was claimed
scenes.text: 1.572T parameters of capacity, but only 49.5B run per token: top-2 of 128 experts.
scenes.say: The claim: one point five seven trillion parameters of capacity, but only forty-nine and a half billion run per token.

steps.say: Each layer holds a hundred and twenty-eight routed experts. A router scores them and keeps the top two.
A shared expert runs on every token and carries the common work, so the routed ones can specialize.
So three of a hundred and twenty-nine fire per token. That's a thirty-two times gap between capacity and compute.

scenes.title: The stretch to a million tokens

items.say: Pretrain on a cheap window of four thousand and ninety-six tokens.
Rescale the rotary position frequencies with YaRN, so far positions stay in distribution.
Do it in two moderate stretches, not one big leap, so long-range attention stays coherent.
The target was a million tokens, with grouped-query attention keeping the cache eight times smaller.

scenes.title: A compute budget that checks out
scenes.say: The training budget even checked out on paper.

parts.note: MoE compute scales with active parameters, not total
parts.say: Training compute scales with the active parameters, not the total.
Times sixty trillion tokens, times six.

parts.note: the reported FLOPs, matched by the estimate
parts.say: That lands on the reported budget.

scenes.quote: the model intended for the public is an inflated version of the original Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct model
scenes.say: Then the retraction. The repository now holds one short README. It says the public model was an inflated Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct, and the big weights are gone.
scenes.label: The retraction

scenes.text: The mechanisms are real techniques. None of it described a model that shipped.
scenes.say: So the mechanisms are real techniques, worth knowing. None of it described a model that shipped.
To recap: top-two routing with a shared expert, a staged stretch to a million tokens, and a model that was retracted.
